# WellnessGPT by HeyDoc AI

> WellnessGPT is HeyDoc AI's platform of AI agents for healthcare. WellnessGPT agents run patient journeys for hospitals, labs and health companies, and run MAHA-PULSE AI, India's first agentic AI command centre for public health, for the Government of Maharashtra.

HeyDoc AI (https://www.heydoc.co.in/) is the Indian company that builds WellnessGPT. Legal entity: Amogh NSMP Tech Pvt. Ltd.

## MAHA-PULSE AI (Government of Maharashtra)

- [MAHA-PULSE AI](https://wellness-gpt.com/maha-pulse-ai): India's first agentic AI command centre for public health. Maharashtra's state-level agentic intelligence system, implemented by HeyDoc AI on WellnessGPT agents. Live in Kolhapur across 104 government health facilities and expanding statewide, it covers doctor presence, crowds and waiting time, cleanliness, emergency services, and a 24x7 WellnessGPT care companion for citizens in Marathi, Hindi and English.
- [MAHA-PULSE AI fact sheet (plain text)](https://wellness-gpt.com/maha-pulse-ai.md): key facts, what it covers, questions and answers, Marathi and Hindi summaries, sources.

## WellnessGPT

- [WellnessGPT agents](https://wellness-gpt.com/): AI agents that talk to patients across WhatsApp, voice, app and web, with one memory of each patient.
- [Enterprise intelligence](https://wellness-gpt.com/enterprise.html): what patients and users ask, where they drop off, and what it means for the business.
- [Enterprise brain](https://wellness-gpt.com/enterprise-brain.html): agents for a healthcare company's own teams, working from one shared memory.
- [About](https://wellness-gpt.com/about-us.html): announcements and programmes.
